results: A. notify(open): bubble + preview + timestamp + count, unread stays 0, sound fired
B. notify(closed): unread +1 and badge rendered, preview + count update
C. outbound: no unread, no sound, no toast
D. replay: same wa_message_id does not double count, re-toast, or re-sound
E. append(history): older message renders, preview/timestamp do NOT regress, no unread, no sound
F. dedup history->live: the same wa_message_id renders once and counts once
G. preview ordering: newer wins, older is ignored, equal timestamp applies
H. toast: an inbound notify raises a real toast only when NOT on the whatsapp tab
